id.description: Stable identifier for this finding, e.g. F001.

file.description: Repo-relative or absolute path of the file the finding points to. Use the path the reviewer cited; do not invent.

line.description: Line number cited by the reviewer. Use 0 if no specific line was given.

description.description: What is wrong and why it matters. Merge complementary descriptions when collapsing duplicates.

suggested_fix.description: Concrete change. May be empty if no reviewer proposed one.

lens_sources.description: Which lenses raised this finding (after dedupe).

verdict_reason.description: Why this verdict. For false_positive, must be code-grounded (cite the specific code that makes the finding wrong); vague reasons will be promoted back to valid by the conductor.

rejected_count.description: How many findings were classified as false_positive in this report.

rejection_summary.description: One-paragraph audit trail of the rejections — what patterns of finding were dismissed and why. Empty string if rejected_count is 0.
